new_defects.statement: a lint or sast run that EXECUTED and reported findings is recorded TOOL_UNRUNNABLE ('tool not installed or cannot load (not found)') when its findings quote source text containing a MISSING_TOOL marker; SS-23 fixed the same shape for `test` only

new_defects.impact_in_this_run: none on any gate: every story's contract is ['unit']; the sast runs were the developer's own `aisef tool sast` checks (implement prompt step 4) — the developer was told its scanner is missing
